title: 第六章：植物学是一门有用的学问
content_zh:
云初想要回归大唐，首先就要完成身份转换，从一个回纥人变成一个真正的唐人，仅仅是这一关，就难如登天，太宗皇帝自己不是纯粹的汉人，却把唐人的标准定的极高，由番入汉绝对不是仅凭一张汉人的脸就能办到的。
即便云初成了一个唐人，那么，他首先面对的将是服兵役，没错，安西军兵员中的府兵，来自大唐各个折冲府，因为距离中原太远，补充兵员的能力很差，所以，安西四镇中的四个长史拥有就地征收兵员的权力，当然，这个征收对象仅限于唐人！
不是成为唐人府兵就自然拥有回归大唐的条件，府兵想要随时回到关内，没有立下三转以上的军功想都不要想，除非遇到折冲府换防！
安西四镇中多的是白发老兵，最早的一批府兵甚至参加过侯君集灭高昌的战事，要知道那已经是十三年前的事情了。
至于三转军功是个什么概念呢？
大军进攻坚城，披甲执锐，冒失雨，避滚木礌石，越壕沟，爬城墙，率先登城，奋勇作战，掩护后军登城，敌军溃，城破——功第一，授军功三转！策勋武散官第二十九阶——陪戎副尉！
云初觉得自己可能办不到……
事实上他根本就办不到！
因为这条晋升之路是留给大唐白丁们的！官员子嗣还有另外一套晋升方略——荐举！
云初现在连大唐白丁都不算，他是铁勒回纥人，还是铁勒回纥人中，完全不以勇勐着称于世的塞人！
用脱落的脚皮来思考也会得出一个正确的答桉——骄傲的唐人不要他！
自己带着塞来玛跟娜哈从龟兹回归长安？
这种假设云初都懒得想，这一路上的强盗，马贼以及平时是牧人，遇见云初这种零散旅客就变成强盗的族群要是少于三千股，云初就当这个天下已经完全太平了。
即便是龟兹城里的那些美丽的歌姬们想要去长安，也是困难重重。
全世界的人都知道唐人好色，对于美丽的女人，不论你是哪一个种族的，只要足够美丽，就能一路畅通地进入长安，获得长安城里的勋贵，富豪，官员，百姓们的欢迎，最后变成长安，洛阳酒肆，饭馆，青楼……等等服务行业的从业人员。
当然，也有更多的美丽女子一辈子都没有抵达长安，洛阳这样的地方，变成了某一个山大王的女人，或者一群土匪的女人。
至于男人——不是黄土埋掉了，就是被贫困的土匪，山贼们放锅里煮了……
这些还不是最大的阻碍，最大的阻碍来自于羯斯噶，这个已经喜欢了塞来玛很多年的男人，他离不开塞来玛，同样的，塞来玛也离不开他。
这两个人的感情，是云初在回纥部落看到的唯一一对比较符合他价值观的爱情。
而他因为已经成年，变成了这两人爱情路上的羁绊。

云初编好了皮鞭，就把这东西泡进化开的温热牛油里，等牛皮完全被牛油浸软之后，打散，再编织一次，这样处理过的牛皮鞭子就不容易皴裂，能用更长的时间。
羯斯噶提着一根大羊腿匆匆地过来了。
看到情郎来了，正在教训娜哈的塞来玛目光立刻从凌厉变得柔和起来。
看到羊腿的娜哈也就停止了哭泣，主要是羯斯噶拿来的那根羊后腿还带着半截羊尾巴，她可是记得哥哥烤羊尾巴油的滋味，那东西一口一包油……
“云初我给你找了一匹马！”羯斯噶把羊腿递给塞来玛就来到云初身边。
云初笑着点点头道： “谢谢羯斯噶大叔，我真的很需要一匹马。”
“其实你是部族里最有前途的小伙子，早就该给你配备一匹马了，就是葛萨路不同意，他总是说
你是恶魔的孩子，不配拥有一匹马。”
羯斯噶嘴里说着担忧的话，脸上却带着笑容，看样子，身为葛萨路大阿波麾下的小土屯，他已经可以绕过那个讨厌的上司干一些能力以外的事情了。
估计这匹马来自昨日的战场。
唐人很喜欢战马，但是呢，龟兹镇唐军的战马太多了，所以，会把一些他们看不上的战马留给帮忙作战的回纥人。
羯斯噶是回纥人的土屯，意思是战士队长，可以领一百个回纥骑兵。
可惜，只能在作战的时候有权力，没有战事的时候，他还是要听部族大阿波葛萨路的。
“您是怎么办到的呢？”云初瞅着塞来玛跟娜哈两人愉快地切割羊腿，心情也变得很好。
看样子这对母女似乎想要吃烤羊肉了。
“昨天的战场上，我杀了一个突厥人，别用那种眼光看我，真的是我杀死的，不是捡唐人剩下不要的脑袋。
我勇勐的样子被昨天带领我们与突厥人作战的比粟特勤给看中了，要我进入他的卫队，从今往后，就不用再参与放牧等闲杂事情了。
我现在是比粟特勤的部下！以后就能无视葛萨路了，云初，你也可以当比粟特勤的部下。”
云初瞅瞅正在远处观望的葛萨路的儿子勐撒卡，摇摇头道： “我现在挺好的，以后有自己的想法，倒是你，羯斯噶，你要小心，我听说比粟一直对他父亲婆润很不满，他可能不是婆润可汗选定的下一任可汗人选。”
羯斯噶笑着把口袋里的洋葱递给云初，没有回答关于比粟特勤的问题，既然已经投靠了比粟特勤，他基本上没有什么退路了。

云初接过洋葱，这是两枚红皮洋葱，很珍贵，是远方的驼队从大小勃律国那边带过来的，应该是比粟特勤赏赐给羯斯噶的。
云初点燃了木炭，将塞来玛跟娜哈穿在红柳树枝上的羊肉串均匀的地在炭火周边，等着被烤熟。
这些羊肉都是被盐水浸泡过的，只要撒上孜然这种西域多得不能再多的东西，美味基本上就算成功了。
被风吹得忽明忽暗的炭火，将羊肉串烤得滋滋作响，同时，孜然的香味也随风飘散了。
云初见羊肉串烤得差不多了，就取下两根递给了娜哈跟塞来玛先吃。
还有跟羯斯噶走的近的牧人也分走了几根，东西不多，也就尝个味道。
娜哈吃得非常忘我，而塞来玛却无心吃，因为葛萨路的儿子勐撒卡流着口水走过来了。
塞来玛很害怕云初又跟这个不要脸的少年起冲突，以前的时候，只要自家吃好吃的东西，勐撒卡都会不要脸地跑过来以他父亲的名义讨要。
云初把一根足够肥硕的羊肉串递给羯斯噶之后，就在其余的羊肉串上重新洒了一些乌头粉增加羊肉的鲜味。
“云初，大阿波有令，牧人必须对腾格尔有敬意，献上你的美食，大阿波需要用它供奉腾格尔。”
勐撒卡说这句话的时候，随时做好了逃跑的准备，不论是羯斯噶，还是云初他都打不过，之所以还没有跑，完全是因为他的父亲葛萨路在他的视线之内。
羯斯噶按住准备起身揍勐撒卡的云初道： “雏鹰会被乌鸦笑话，也会被麻雀戏弄，云初，再等等，等你彻底长成雄鹰，那时候你会发现，无论是乌鸦还是麻雀都不值得你张一张翅膀！”
云初阴沉着脸，没有起身，抬头看看勐撒卡紫青色的嘴唇，就把剩下的羊肉串都递给了这位嘴唇已经出现紫绀症状的乌头碱重度中毒患者。
“如果不够，等一会再来拿，腾格尔喜欢吃我烤的羊肉，这是我的荣幸，也请大阿波尝尝我烹调出来的美味，也希望你家帐篷里的每一个人都喜欢。
勐撒卡见云初低头了，就得意地道： “我父亲当然会吃，每一次都属他吃的最多。
云初，我父亲说过，你只要乖乖地听话，他就不动你帐篷里的人。”
云初弯下身子抚胸施礼道： “遵命。”
瞅着勐撒卡得意洋洋地拿着一大把烤羊肉离开，羯斯噶皱眉道： “也不能这么没脾气吧？”
云初把眼睛里噙着两大泡眼泪的娜哈抱在怀里，替她擦掉眼泪，又把塞来玛刚刚穿好的羊肉重新插在炭火周围，好像完全没有感受到屈辱一般对羯斯噶道： “你有机会成为大阿波吗？
我是说，比粟特勤会不会支持你当我们这两百帐回纥人的大阿波？”

很久以前就不把云初当孩子看的羯斯噶摇摇头。
“葛萨路是我们部族中出了名的勇士，跟他作战我不是对手，同时呢，婆润可汗也不会允许比粟特勤用我替换属于他的人。”
云初低着头想了一下，按理说，葛萨路已经吃了不下十次添加了草乌的美食，既然勐撒卡面部已经出现了紫绀症状，那么，吃了更多美食的葛萨路的中毒症状应该更加的严重才对，可是，这个家伙在前天还参与了驯野马这样的剧烈的运动，看不出有什么不对。
初步的乌头中毒症状应该是呼吸急促，然后是咳嗽、接下来应该出现血痰、再然后就是呼吸困难、呼吸困难之后因为血液中供氧量不足就会出现紫绀症状。
紫绀症状出现之后呢，就证明毒药正在侵犯他的肺部，会引起急促的呼吸行为，呼吸的太急促会损伤肺部得急性肺水肿这种病。
一般出现急性肺肿病，就要用大量的消炎药消炎，还需要注射镇定剂，使用利尿剂，上氧气。
云初认为葛萨路不具备拥有这些东西的可能。
既然没有可能，那么，他只剩下因呼吸肌痉挛而窒息这一条路可走了。
content_en:
If Yun Chu wants to return to the Tang Dynasty, he must first complete the identity transformation, from a Huihe to a real Tang Dynasty. Just this step is as difficult as climbing to the sky. Emperor Taizong himself was not a pure Han, but he set the standards of the Tang people extremely high. Transitioning from Huihe to a real Tang Dynasty is definitely not something that can be accomplished with just a Han face.
Even if Yunchu becomes a Tang man, the first thing he will face is military service. Yes, the soldiers in the Anxi army come from various Zichong mansions in the Tang Dynasty. Because they are too far away from the Central Plains, the ability to replenish soldiers is very poor. Therefore, the four chief historians in the four towns of Anxi have the power to recruit soldiers on the spot. Of course, this recruitment is limited to Tang people!
Being a soldier of the Tang Dynasty does not mean that you will automatically have the conditions to return to the Tang Dynasty. If the soldiers of the Tang Dynasty want to return to the pass at any time, they should not even think about it if they have not achieved military merit of level three or above, unless they encounter a change of defense!
There are many white-haired veterans in the four towns of Anxi. The earliest batch of soldiers even participated in the war when Hou Junji destroyed Gaochang. You must know that it was already thirteen years ago.
As for the concept of third-level military merit?
The army attacks the fortified city, wears armor and carries sharp swords, braves the rain, avoids rolling logs and stones, crosses trenches, climbs the city wall, takes the lead to climb the city, fights bravely, covers the rear troops as they climb the city, the enemy army collapses, and the city is broken - the first in merit, awarded the third rank of military merit! The twenty-ninth rank of Cexun Wu Sanguan - deputy lieutenant accompanying Rong!
Yun Chu felt that he might not be able to do it...
In fact, he couldn't do it at all!
Because this road to promotion is reserved for the white men of the Tang Dynasty! The heirs of officials have another promotion strategy - recommendation!
Yun Chu is not even counted as Bai Ding of the Tang Dynasty. He is a Tiele Uihe, or a Cypriot among the Tiele Uihe people who is not famous for his bravery at all!
Thinking about the peeled foot skin will also lead to a correct answer - the proud Tang people don't want him!
Will he return to Chang'an from Qiuci with Selema and Naha?
Yun Chu didn't bother to think about this assumption. If the number of bandits, horse thieves, and herders who turned into bandits when they met stray travelers like Yun Chu were less than 3,000, Yun Chu would think that the world was completely peaceful.
Even the beautiful singers in Kucha City have many difficulties if they want to go to Chang'an.
People all over the world know that the Tang people were lustful. As for beautiful women, no matter what race you are, as long as you are beautiful enough, you can enter Chang'an smoothly, and be welcomed by the nobles, rich, officials and ordinary people in Chang'an City, and finally become employees of Chang'an, Luoyang wine shops, restaurants, brothels... and other service industries.
Of course, there are also more beautiful women who never reach Chang'an in their lifetime. In places like Luoyang, they become the women of a certain mountain king or a group of bandits.
As for men - they were either buried in the loess or boiled in a pot by impoverished bandits and bandits...
These are not the biggest obstacles. The biggest obstacle comes from Jiesika, a man who has liked Selema for many years. He can't live without Selema, and Selama can't live without him.
The relationship between these two people is the only love pair that Yunchu has seen in the Huihe tribe that is more in line with his values.
And because he has reached adulthood, he has become the bond between these two people on their love journey.
After Yunchu had braided the whip, he soaked it in warm butter. After the cowhide was completely soaked in butter, he broke it up and knitted it again. This way, the treated cowhide whip would be less likely to crack and could be used for a longer time.
Jiesga hurried over carrying a large leg of lamb.
Seeing her lover coming, Selema's eyes, which were teaching Naha a lesson, immediately changed from sharp to soft.
Naha stopped crying when she saw the lamb leg. The main reason was that the lamb hind leg that Jiesga brought still had half of the lamb tail. She remembered the taste of her brother's roasted lamb tail oil. That thing came with a packet of oil...
"Yunchu, I found a horse for you!"He handed the leg of lamb to Selema and came to Yun Chu's side.
Yunchu smiled and nodded and said, "Thank you, Uncle Jiesga, I really need a horse."
"Actually, you are the most promising young man in the tribe. I should have equipped you with a horse a long time ago. But Gesalu didn't agree. He always said
You are a child of the devil and do not deserve a horse. "
Jiesiga said worried words, but with a smile on his face. It seemed that as a small village under the command of Gesalu Da Abo, he could already bypass that annoying boss and do some things beyond his capabilities.
It is estimated that this horse came from yesterday's battlefield.
People in the Tang Dynasty liked war horses very much, but the Tang army in Kucha Town had too many war horses, so some of the war horses they disdained were left to the Uighurs who helped fight.
Jiesika is a Uighur village, which means a warrior captain who can lead one hundred Uighur cavalry.
It's a pity that he can only have power when fighting. When there is no war, he still has to listen to the tribe's leader Abogesalu.
"How did you do it?" Yunchu watched Selema and Naha happily cutting the leg of lamb, and his mood became very good.
It looked like the mother and daughter wanted to eat roast lamb.
"On the battlefield yesterday, I killed a Turk. Don't look at me like that. It was really me who killed him, and I didn't pick up the Tang people's unwanted heads.
My brave appearance was noticed by Bisoqin, who led us to fight against the Turks yesterday, and asked me to join his guard. From now on, I no longer have to participate in herding and other chores.
I am now a subordinate who works harder than Sogdiana! From now on, you can ignore Gesalu. Yunchu, you can also be a more diligent subordinate than Sogdiya. "
Yunchu glanced at Gesalu's son Meng Saka, who was watching from a distance, shook his head and said: "I'm fine now, but I will have my own ideas in the future. But you, Jiesika, you have to be careful. I heard that Bisu has always been very dissatisfied with his father Porun, and he may not be the next candidate chosen by Porun Khan."
Jiesiga smiled and handed the onions in his pocket to Yun Chu, without answering the question about Bisu Deqin. Since he had surrendered to Bisu Deqin, he basically had no way out.
Yun Chu took the onions. They were two red onions. They were very precious. They were brought by camel teams from the Great and Little Bolü Kingdom. They should have been given to Jiesga by Bi Sogdien Qin.
Yunchu lit the charcoal and placed Selema and Naha's mutton skewers on the red willow branches evenly around the charcoal fire, waiting to be roasted.
These muttons have been soaked in salt water. As long as you sprinkle cumin, which is abundant in the Western Regions, it will basically be delicious.
The charcoal fire, blown by the wind, made the mutton skewers sizzle. At the same time, the scent of cumin also drifted away with the wind.
When Yun Chu saw that the mutton skewers were almost cooked, he took off two and handed them to Naha and Selema to eat first.
There were also some shepherds who were close to Jiesga who also took away a few sticks. There wasn’t much, so I just had a taste.
Naha ate very selflessly, but Selema had no intention of eating because Gesalu's son Meng Saka came over drooling.
Selema was very afraid that Yunchu would have another conflict with this shameless young man. In the past, whenever his family ate delicious food, Meng Saka would shamelessly come over to ask for it in the name of his father.
After Yunchu handed a fat enough mutton skewer to Jiesga, he sprinkled some aconite powder on the rest of the mutton skewers to increase the umami flavor of the mutton.
"Yunchu, Da Apo has an order. The shepherds must respect Tengger and offer your delicacies. Da Apo needs to use it to worship Tengger."
When Meng Saka said this, he was ready to escape at any time. He could not defeat either Jiesika or Yunchu. The reason why he had not run away yet was entirely because his father Gesalu was within his sight.
Jiesiga held down Yunchu who was about to stand up and beat Meng Saka and said: "The young eagle will be killed by the crow.Even if you are a joke, you will also be teased by sparrows. Yun Chu, wait a moment, when you have completely grown into an eagle, you will realize that neither a crow nor a sparrow is worthy of your wings! "
Yunchu had a gloomy face and did not stand up. He looked up at Meng Saka's purple lips and handed the remaining mutton skewers to the patient with severe aconitine poisoning who had cyanosis on his lips.
"If it's not enough, come back later. Tengger likes to eat my roasted mutton. This is my honor. I also invite Da Apo to taste the delicious food I cook. I hope everyone in your tent likes it."
When Meng Saka saw Yunchu bowing his head, he said proudly: "Of course my father knows how to eat, he eats the most every time.
Yunchu, my father said that as long as you are obedient, he will not touch the people in your tent. "
Yun Chu bent down, caressed his chest and saluted, "Yes."
Watching Meng Saka leave triumphantly with a large handful of roasted lamb, Jiesiga frowned and said, "You can't be so temperamental, right?"
Yunchu held Naha in his arms, who had tears in her eyes, wiped away her tears, and put the mutton that Selema had just dressed around the charcoal fire again, as if he didn't feel the humiliation at all, and said to Jiesga: "Do you have a chance to become the Great Apo?
I mean, will Bi Sogdiqin support you as the great Apo of our two hundred Huihe people? "
Jiesika, who had stopped treating Yunchu as a child a long time ago, shook his head.
"Gesalu is a well-known warrior in our tribe. I am no match against him. At the same time, Porun Khan will not allow Bisogqin to replace one of his men with me."
Yunchu lowered his head and thought for a moment. It stands to reason that Gesalu had eaten delicacies with added cucumbers no less than ten times. Since Meng Saka's face had already developed symptoms of cyanosis, Gesalu's poisoning symptoms should have been more serious after eating more delicacies. However, this guy also participated in strenuous sports such as taming wild horses the day before yesterday, so there was nothing wrong with it.
The initial symptoms of aconitum poisoning should be shortness of breath, then coughing, followed by bloody sputum, and then difficulty breathing. After difficulty breathing, cyanosis symptoms will appear due to insufficient oxygen supply in the blood.
After the symptoms of cyanosis appear, it proves that the poison is invading his lungs and will cause rapid breathing. Breathing too quickly will damage the lungs and cause acute pulmonary edema.
Generally, when acute lung disease occurs, a large amount of anti-inflammatory drugs must be used to reduce inflammation, and it is also necessary to inject sedatives, use diuretics, and provide oxygen.
Yunchu thought that Gesalu had no possibility of possessing these things.
Since it was impossible, the only option left for him was to suffocate due to respiratory muscle spasm.
